description: Polygon PoS fee reference. A static snapshot captured 2026-11-14, no input: the EIP-1559-style fee mechanics with the mandatory 25 gwei minimum priority fee, the observed 30-100 gwei typical base-fee band with the 2026 monthly averages, and transfer and swap cost scenarios computed at the band edges and the reference POL price, the capture date printed on every card. Price: $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: polygon-fee-snapshot
